patterns.note: Sections frequently alternate between full-width content blocks and split layouts featuring large, high-quality imagery alongside text, often with generous vertical padding.
A sophisticated serif typeface is used for primary headings and brand elements, contrasting with a clean, legible sans-serif for body text and navigation, creating an elegant yet modern feel.
The palette relies on a deep, rich navy/charcoal as a primary background and text color, complemented by warm off-whites and a distinctive golden-tan accent for headings and key elements.

The hero section features a full-bleed video that plays automatically. As the user scrolls down, the main navigation bar at the top of the page transitions from a transparent, slightly larger state to a smaller, sticky bar with a solid dark background.
Many content sections are introduced with large, impactful photography or video, often full-bleed, emphasizing visual storytelling and product craftsmanship.

technique_notes: The site employs a smooth scrolling experience, likely using a library like locomotive-scroll, which also orchestrates scroll-triggered animations. Sections are revealed with a gentle fade-up or slide-in motion as they become visible in the viewport.
The hero section utilizes a full-bleed video background that remains fixed or subtly parallaxes as content scrolls over it, creating depth and an immersive introduction.

The primary navigation bar dynamically shrinks in height and gains a solid dark background when the user scrolls past the initial hero section, becoming a sticky element at the top of the page for persistent access.

design_tokens.type_scale: Elegant, large serif headings (up to ~3-4x body text) paired with smaller, highly legible sans-serif body text. Some uppercase sans-serif labels for buttons and navigation.
design_tokens.spacing: airy hero and between major sections, creating a sense of luxury and space; content within sections is balanced.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a full-bleed, high-quality video hero combined with elegant serif typography and a restrained, luxurious color palette immediately conveys a sense of heritage and high craftsmanship. The design prioritizes large, impactful imagery and generous white space to highlight the product's prestige rather than relying on dense information.
